summary: 41 units reviewed. Patches: 7 errors (u221 added numeral/Hindi/note, u229 English 'the body'/'just', u236 Hindi 'आदि वाले', u243 unmarked conjecture in both languages), many minor (gram numerals/dual, Hindi hedges missing for yoni/pakvāśaya/garbhaśayyā/ārtava/pitta/vasā/medas, supplied words '(ones)', 'school', '(it)', 'of', two missing text_flags in u231 and u235). No identification judged wrong (rohita = Labeo rohita standard; others properly probable). Units needing a human decision: 221, 224, 229, 231, 233, 235, 236, 239, 245. No regrouping suggested beyond the GROUPING notes already present.
glossary_suggestions: yoni: this chapter reads it as the whole female genital tract (the garbhaśayyā sits in its third whorl, u224), 'yoni (female genital tract, probably)'; p02 ch01 k3 fixed 'yoni (vagina)'. Owner to decide which wins; keep one rule.
lasīkā = lymph / tissue fluid (probable); vasā = muscle-fat (probable); medas = adipose tissue (probable); pitta in the fluid-measure list = probably bile; hedged in both languages.
ārtava and rajas (women) = menstrual blood, hedged 'probably' in both languages in every unit; Hindi 'आर्तव यानी सम्भवतः मासिक धर्म के रक्त' (bare रज is ambiguous).
mūrta/amūrta = corporeal/non-corporeal; mūrtimat = having form; paramāṇu = atom; avayava = part.
Hindi śatasahasra = लाख (hundred-thousand); printed counts kept as printed (u227 = 29 hundred-thousands and 956).
dvau is masculine only, dve is nom. du. with no gender; daśa and other numerals above four 'nom. pl.' (already in glossary, repeat for sweep: ch05 u216-221, 240).
añjali is a masculine i-stem; u239 'añjalyaḥ' f. follows printed catasraḥ - OPEN.

OPEN p02 ch05 k6: u221 only two dve printed (2+2 here, 3 in u222); u224 tryāvartā conjecture; u231 tat/tan and destination of nayanti; u234 mūrtimantaḥ sthirāḥ vs mūrtimanto 'sthirāḥ'; u235 syntax and Hindi बाँधता; u236 ādya scope and lasīkā; u239 añjalyaḥ gender and u240 dvau; u245 māṃsa-karṇādi-malān; u227 count 2,900,956 vs another witness 29,956.
